$Comment: What a participant sees when the Scarak Brood Queen is left standing: the last of the party
died or walked off and stayed away past the fight's WipeGraceSeconds, and the library settled
the run as lost. The queen's binding row points its Wiped beat here (Feedback.Wiped), so the
words belong to this fight alone.
A quiet line in the plain tone, on purpose: the screen already went grey, and this only says
who kept the hive. She stays where she was left, at the health she was left with, for the next
party. It fires once per participant and carries 'share' and 'seconds' should a line want them.
